# Altar Life Sciences

> > Altar Life Sciences (Nu-Alter Remedies) - ISO/WHO-GMP certified pharmaceutical manufacturer offering PCD franchise, third-party manufacturing, and monopoly distribution rights across India for pharma, herbal, ayurvedic, and veterinary products.

Based in Panchkula, India, Altar Life Sciences operates under the Nu-Alter Remedies brand, providing comprehensive pharmaceutical franchise opportunities with monopoly rights across multiple states. The company specializes in allopathic medicines, herbal remedies, ayurvedic formulations, and veterinary products, all manufactured under ISO and WHO-GMP certifications.
